messages:
maya: Dry run of the customer-facing comms for the audit-event schema changes and expanded coverage. Posting the draft + sample events + validation output. Please review by EOD and call out anything that would be a legal/compliance blocker. Link: https://redwood-internal.docs/audit-comms/dryrun :eyes:
liam: Got it — reading now. Quick Q: where do we list breaking field mappings so integrators can update their parsers?
sandra: We should be explicit about PII handling. Any field named `request_body` or `response_body` must be redacted or sampled in exported logs. Call out the redaction policy in the changelog.
eldar: For KMS things: adding these event types: `kms.key.rotate`, `kms.key.revoke`, `kms.key.grant`. Suggest mapping to `audit.event_type = \"kms.key.rotate\"` and include `key_id` and `actor` only. Do NOT include key material. Example snippet:
```json
{
  "event": "kms.key.rotate",
  "key_id": "projects/prod/keys/kv-1234",
  "actor": "alice@example.com",
  "timestamp": "2025-06-12T14:22:00Z"
}
```
zara: PM ask — can we add a preview toggle so select customers can opt into the new audit schema before GA? We want a way to test parsing on their side.
pm-oliver: Yes, preview toggle sounds good. Need to confirm timeframe; if we get sign-off today we can enable a controlled rollout next week. Also: include sample webhook payloads in the doc.
legal-jen: I skimmed the comms. Two things: 1) wording around "audit exports" must clarify sample rate and opt-in; 2) mention that KMS events do not contain secret material. I'll add comments in the doc.
deploy-bot: Validation job `audit-schema-dryrun` finished. Summary: 27 checks passed, 3 failed. Failures: missing `actor` on 2 samples, `request_body` contains raw PII on 1 sample. Full output: 
```
FAILED: sample_021.json - missing field: actor
FAILED: sample_042.json - missing field: actor
FAILED: sample_118.json - redaction violation: request_body contains email addresses
```
maya: Thanks — I'll patch the two samples and remove the raw `request_body` from sample_118. Also adding an explicit validation rule to reject events with unmasked emails in payload fields.
liam: Also flagging RBAC events as security-critical in the changelog: `role.assign`, `role.revoke`, `role.update-membership`. Customers should get these delivered synchronously in exports (not sampled).
sandra: Add a short note for vuln triage: if an event indicates a secret exposure or key compromise we should trigger the IR playbook. Link to playbook: https://redwood-internal.runbooks/ir/audit-key-compromise
eldar: One more KMS nit: add telemetry field `kms_key_version` so rotations can be correlated across systems. Not in the payload body, but as top-level metadata.
maya: Draft changelog bullets (for review):
- "New: expanded audit coverage for KMS operations (kms.key.rotate, kms.key.revoke, kms.key.grant). No key material is ever emitted."
- "Changed: audit event schema v3 renames `user` -> `actor` and `action` -> `event` (backwards-compatible aliases supported for 30 days)."
- "Security: RBAC events (role.assign, role.revoke, role.update-membership) are now marked as security-critical and are exempt from sampling in exports."
- "Policy: fields that may contain PII (request_body/response_body) will be redacted/sampled by default; customers can opt into full export under contractual review."
liam: Those bullets look good. Suggest we also include a small migration table showing old -> new field names (one-liner).
legal-jen: I'll review the exact phrasing for the "opt-in" and add the required contractual language.
pm-oliver: Once legal signs off, ops and SRE, please run one more validation and coordinate enabling the preview toggle for the select pilot customers. Target: next Tuesday 2025-06-17.
maya: Updated the doc with fixes and the migration table. Re-ran validation locally: 30/30 passing. I'll post the updated doc and ping legal for final review. If all clear, plan to send customer preview invites on Monday and GA announcement the following week. :thumbsup:
zara: Thanks everyone — ping me when legal confirms. I'll prep the customer comms and support playbook for the pilot.
maya: Will do. Closing dry run for now, will reopen thread with final doc link and sign-off notes.
